newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU still awaits Thomson reply on recapitalisation.
newsitem.headline: EU still awaits Thomson reply on recapitalisation.

text.p: The European Commission is still waiting for France to provide information about the recapitalisation of defence and consumer electronics group Thomson SA, European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Tuesday.
"I'm still waiting for an answer," Van Miert said in reply to questions from reporters.
"I can only put the case to my colleagues when I have all the answers."
France has requested EU approval to recapitalise Thomson SA by 10.8 billion francs prior to the sale of Thomson-CSF to Lagardere and Thomson Multimedia (TMM) to Daewoo Electronics.
Van Miert would not comment on the transactions themselves which are being investigated under EU rules banning creation or strengthening of dominant positions in the Union.

According to a letter published in Le Monde this weekend, Van Miert gave French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis until last Monday to provide a restructuring plan for Thomson that would ensure the firm's long-term viability, and the assurance that TMM's market share would remain frozen for the duration of the plan.

The Commission is expected to clear the sale of Thomson-CSF and TMM on Wednesday, sources said. But a decision on the capital injection may have to wait until December 18, which is when the Commission last meets before its Christmas break.
